scope: Declared derived text inputs for supplemental documents whose downloadable artifact has no native text layer. A build verifies the download against the original-bytes identity, verifies the pinned text against its own identity, and uses the pinned text instead of re-running OCR.

hash_roles.origin.sha256: identity of the bytes served by the declared download URL (original image-only scan)
hash_roles.derived_artifact.sha256: identity of the locally OCR'd PDF that produced the text; equal to sources-v2.json source_sha256, recorded but not re-derived by this build because OCR output bytes are not reproducible
hash_roles.text.sha256: canonical identity of the pinned, committed text input that this build reads

inputs.reason: The NRC ML18086B223.pdf scan and its OSTI 515583 alternate both carry zero native text words, so pdftotext on either returns nothing. The corpus text comes from a real OCR layer placed over the OSTI scan.

origin.note: OSTI record 515583, canonical purl, HTTP 200; Image Alchemy scan of the same report. Preserved unchanged as the authoritative page images.

derived_artifact.note: OCR text layer over the untouched scan page images, one text layer per source page; page count and page size preserved. Byte-identical regeneration is not deterministic, so this artifact is an identity record only.

text.note: Exact layout text of the OCR PDF, committed as the pinned input because the OCR PDF bytes are not reproducible. The 12 procedural chunks and the document text_sha256 are derived from this text with the same paragraph and chunk-selection rule as every other PDF.

ocr.required_because: both the NRC ML18086B223.pdf scan and the OSTI 515583 scan have 0 native text words
ocr.engine: tesseract 5.5.0 (leptonica 1.86.0), eng, --psm 3, 300 dpi grayscale raster from pdftoppm
ocr.text_layer_insertion: PyMuPDF 2.1, invisible render mode 3, DejaVu Sans 4-8 pt, one OCR line per extracted line; blank separator lines preserved
ocr.no_synthesis: No word, number, or sentence was added, inferred, or repaired; a small number of OCR artefacts remain (hyphen splits, misread punctuation).
ocr.tools_not_needed: The OCR toolchain is not a build prerequisite: this build reads the committed text and never re-runs OCR.
